name: spend.continue
description: Keep, cut, pause or renegotiate a tool, ad or subscription at review time. Input is one spend row: item, monthly and annual cost, who uses it, what it was bought for, last real use, and any revenue or client linkage.

usage.instructions: How much evidence this item is actually used, from the row -- not how much it was hoped to be used
criteria: No usage evidence at all -- nobody can name the last real use
A claim of use with no log, no export, and no named user
One named user or one logged use in the last 30 days
Weekly use by a named person against a named workflow
Daily use tied to a client deliverable, a shipped routine, or a revenue step

revenue_link.instructions: There is a named, evidenced link between this spend and revenue, a signed client deliverable, or a compliance requirement -- 'it might help us grow' is not a link.

cost_material.instructions: The cost is material enough to review: $50 or more per month, any annual prepay, any ad budget, or any seat count above five.

covered_elsewhere.instructions: A cheaper or free local alternative already in the estate does the same job -- for example a local model, an existing tool, or a script that already exists.

decision.instructions: What should happen to this spend at this review

criteria.keep: Keep paying: it is used and it pays for itself
criteria.cut: Cancel or do not renew: it is not used and it does not pay for itself
criteria.pause_pending_evidence: Pause or hold the renewal until usage or revenue evidence appears
criteria.renegotiate: Keep the capability but change the plan, the seat count, or the vendor

needs_review.instructions: This spend needs a review decision rather than an auto-renew: the cost is material ($50+/month, any annual prepay, any ad budget, or more than five seats) AND it lacks either real usage evidence or a revenue link.

rules.reason: cutting spend is a Gate-D action -- Mike approves the cancellation, the gate only recommends it
no usage evidence -- do not renew this blind
no revenue or client linkage -- the spend is unsupported
already covered by something cheaper in the estate -- consolidate candidate
material spend without usage or revenue evidence -- Mike reviews it instead of it auto-renewing
usage evidence is not readable from the row -- gather it before deciding

notes.direction: The keep/cut recommendation is decision.choice. Nothing here cancels anything: cancellation is a Gate-D action and the gate only recommends it.
notes.why_composite: needs_review is deliberately one composite statement (material AND unsupported) because the rule engine takes a single condition per rule -- a bare cost_material rule would escalate every well-evidenced $200/mo tool and a gate that flags good work gets switched off.
notes.thresholds: Provisional and uncalibrated; BLOCK rules would report ESCALATE with a downgraded-BLOCK reason until calibrated (law 3).
